dataset.name: DeepCode smoke benchmark
dataset.description: Low-cost dry-run fixture for validating BenchmarkHarness wiring.

tasks.title: Tool repair metadata summary
tasks.prompt: Given a failed tool call with invalid JSON input, produce a concise repair summary and do not rerun successful tools.

expectedOutcome.summary: Only failed retryable tool calls are summarized for the next model turn.
assertions: Successful tool calls are not repeated.

tasks.title: Benchmark report ordering
tasks.prompt: Compare two candidate task results and report the better candidate by resolved rate, verification rate, cost, turns, and regression count.

expectedOutcome.summary: Reporter output is deterministic and sorted by benchmark quality.
assertions: Markdown output follows the same candidate ordering.
